blurb: Guests fish the Gulf Stream and inshore waters with Captain Tore, a two-time Silver Sailfish Derby champion. Trips include half-day, full-day, inshore, offshore, swordfishing, and custom options. The boat is a 2001 31' Contender equipped with state-of-the-art gear and safety features.
extraNote: Bookings handled directly by calling Captain Tore; no online or third-party booking · Guests should provide group size, dates, and trip interest when booking · Departing from Riviera Beach marina, minutes from West Palm Beach inshore waters and the Gulf Stream.
